picks.file: Vista da cidade de Braga c1849-1873.jpg
picks.what: View from the tower of São Vicente, photograph
picks.why: panorama over the roofs to the cathedral towers and churches on the skyline

picks.what: The city from Bom Jesus, photograph
picks.why: recent daytime general view of the whole city; trimmed to the middle of a very wide panorama

gaps: P0: no candidates. P2, P3: none. P5: only #5, a Cávado valley landscape without the city.
notes: The Braun and Hogenberg plate is dated 1594 on Commons (the plan’s own date); it was first published in vol. 5 (1598). #2 (two-page spread in a 1617 edition) and #3 (1640 BnF copy) are the same plate. #4 is dated only ‘about 1849–1873’. P6 alternatives: #6 (Bom Jesus terrace with the city behind), #8/#9 (sunset panoramas from Sameiro, hazier).
